title: Fallout 2 Skynet Alien-Technology Source Binding Audit
scope: Determine exactly what shipped Fallout 2 establishes when Skynet says alien technology was used to perfect a thinking computer, and prevent generic alien-technology ancestry from being overexpanded into a specific Zetan/component claim.

primary_shipped_source.speaker: Skynet
primary_shipped_source.statement_semantics: Skynet states that it was conceived/developed in 2050 and that a new thinking computer was perfected through use of alien technology; it then dates its later self-awareness to 2081.

provenance_layers.claim: The statement refers to Skynet / AI project 59234.
Skynet is a Sierra Army Depot / U.S. military research system.
Alien technology contributed to perfecting the new thinking computer.
A named alien chip, crystal, processor, memory device, saucer part or weapon component was used.
The Sierra project acquired the alien technology through a named crash recovery, Area 51 transfer, Shi program or other specified event.

Sierra_Depot_search_result.finding: No reviewed shipped Sierra Army Depot record upgrades Skynet's generic 'alien technology' phrase to a specific artifact or species.

cross_game_significance.Fallout2: An artificial intelligence directly attributes part of its technological ancestry to alien technology.
cross_game_significance.Fallout3: Mothership Zeta later exposes an active alien civilization, material technology, collection system and long-duration human experimentation.
cross_game_significance.allowed_parallel: The franchise contains an early alien-technology-to-AI provenance statement before Mothership Zeta makes alien contact systemic.
cross_game_significance.forbidden_parallel: Fallout 2 proves Zetans built Skynet or supplied a crystal memory device.

next_gate.name: CROSS_GAME_ALIEN_TECH_OBJECT_PROVENANCE_GRAPH
targets: separate every shipped alien-named object from every object with explicit extraterrestrial provenance
track alien blaster and power-cell appearances across Fallout 1/2/3
keep Fallout2 Skynet generic alien-tech ancestry as a source node with UNKNOWN donor/component
test whether later games retroactively source-bind any Sierra/Skynet technology without treating non-game lore as shipped Fallout2 evidence
